judul: Module 4: Loves and Hates (Present Simple he/she, like + -ing)

hero.title: Ceritakan Apa yang Disukai Orang Lain
hero.text: Present simple he/she/it (verb + -s, doesn't, Does…?), like/love/hate + -ing, kata kerja aktivitas, adverbs of frequency, serta meminta dengan sopan (I'd like…, Do you want…?).

cheatsheet.heading: Aturan emas Module 4
cheatsheet.html: Untuk he / she / it (satu orang/benda selain I dan you), kata kerja positif mendapat -s/-es: He hates spiders. She loves dolls. Di negatif dan pertanyaan, -s pindah ke does: He doesn't like clowns. Does she like London?

cheatsheet.label: Interaktif 1 • Pola he/she
cheatsheet.title: Present Simple untuk he / she / it
rows: She lives in London. He watches TV.
She doesn't watch TV. (= does not)
Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't.
Does she like London? Yes, she does.
Where does she come from? What does she think about British people?

modes.label: Jebakan utama
modes.title: Tidak ada -s ganda
modes.text: ❌ Does she likes? ✅ Does she like? (NOT: Does she likes?) — catatan langsung dari modul.

modes.label: Irregular
modes.title: have, go, do
modes.text: have → has (She has hundreds of dolls), go → goes, do → does (He often does the housework).

cheatsheet.label: Interaktif 2 • Ejaan -s / -es / -ies
cheatsheet.title: Aturan Menambah -s (Study modul)
rows: work → works, know → knows, run → runs
watch → watches, finish → finishes, miss → misses, go → goes, do → does
fly → flies, study → studies, carry → carries
play → plays, stay → stays, say → says

modes.label: Pelafalan /s/
modes.title: Tiga bunyi -s
modes.text: /s/ books, likes • /z/ loves, newspapers • /ɪz/ watches, places. Bunyi /ɪz/ muncul setelah s, sh, ch, x.

modes.label: Jebakan y
modes.title: play ≠ plaies
modes.text: Sebelum y ada vokal (a) → cukup tambah s: plays.

options.label: ❤️❤️ love
options.title: love + noun / -ing
options.code: She loves cycling in London parks.

options.label: ❤️ like
options.title: like + -ing
options.code: Do you like cooking? — No, I don't. I hate it.
options.text: Suka. Setelah like/love/hate, kata kerja berikutnya biasanya -ing.

options.label: 😐 okay
options.title: I think … is okay / don't mind ➕
options.code: I think swimming is okay. I don't mind cooking.

options.label: 💔 hate
options.title: hate / don't like
options.code: He hates spiders. Harrison Ford doesn't like doing housework.

cheatsheet.label: Interaktif 4 • Adverbs of Frequency
cheatsheet.title: Dari 0% sampai 100%
rows: I always read the newspaper in the morning.
I usually listen to the radio in the car.
I often go shopping on Saturday.
I never watch football on television.

modes.label: Posisi
modes.title: Sebelum kata kerja utama
modes.text: Adverb of frequency diletakkan sebelum verb di kalimat positif, dan setelah don't/doesn't di kalimat negatif: I don't often….

modes.label: ➕ Dengan be
modes.title: Setelah be
modes.text: Dengan to be, adverb diletakkan setelah be: She is always late.

flashcards.q: Positif he/she untuk like, watch, study, have?

flashcards.a: S + doesn't + V1: She doesn't watch TV.
Salah → Does she like London? (-s hanya sekali, di does).
Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.
Konsonan + y: study → studies, fly → flies. Vokal + y cukup -s: plays.
/s/ books, likes • /z/ loves, newspapers • /ɪz/ watches, places.
Bentuk -ing: I love swimming. She hates doing housework.
always > usually > often > sometimes > not often > never.
Sebelum kata kerja utama; setelah be; setelah don't (I don't often…).
play football/the guitar; go swimming/shopping; do your homework/nothing.
I'd like (= I would like) …, please. Excuse me. I'd like the bill, please.
Do you want …? (lebih sopan ➕: Would you like …?)
No, thanks. I'm fine. / It's okay, I've got one, thank you.

ringkasan:
*RANGKUMAN P5 BAHASA INGGRIS: LOVES AND HATES*
1️⃣ he/she/it + V1-s: lives, watches (-es), studies (-ies), plays, has, goes, does.
2️⃣ (−) doesn't + V1 • (?) Does + S + V1? • Yes, she does / No, she doesn't. (NOT Does she likes)
3️⃣ like/love/hate + -ing: I love swimming. He hates doing housework.
4️⃣ always > usually > often > sometimes > not often > never. Posisi: sebelum verb, setelah be, setelah don't.
5️⃣ play football, go swimming, do homework, listen to the radio.
6️⃣ Sopan: I'd like …, please. Do you want …? No, thanks. I'm fine.

materi.label: Bagian 1
materi.title: Isi Module 4
materi.html:
Module 4 Loves and hates membahas: present simple untuk he dan she; like … -ing; pertanyaan; kata kerja aktivitas dan adverbs of frequency; listening tentang hal yang disukai/dibenci selebritas; bacaan An American star in London … and a British star in Hollywood; tugas mencari teman e-mail; dan real life: meminta dengan sopan.

Listening pembuka: selebritas yang suka atau benci dog, doll, clown, crowd, spider, TV, flying, doing housework. Contoh kalimat modul: Cameron Diaz doesn't watch TV. Johnny Depp hates clowns. Dean Cain never goes on planes. Britney Spears has hundreds of dolls.

parts.label: Subjek
parts.title: he / she / it
parts.text: Termasuk nama satu orang (Madonna, my father) atau satu benda (the film, the shop).

parts.label: Positif
parts.title: Kata kerja + s
parts.text: Tanpa auxiliary, -s menempel di kata kerja: likes, watches, studies, has.

parts.label: Negatif
parts.title: doesn't membawa -s
parts.text: does = do + es. Karena -s sudah dibawa doesn't, kata kerja kembali ke bentuk dasar.

parts.label: Tanya
parts.title: Does membawa -s
parts.text: Does di depan subjek, kata kerja bentuk dasar. NOT: Does she likes?

parts.label: V1 dasar
parts.title: Tanpa -s
parts.text: like, watch, study, have (bukan has!): Does she have a car?

parts.label: Jawaban
parts.title: Short answer
parts.text: Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't. Jangan menjawab “Yes, she likes.”

materi.label: Bagian 2
materi.title: Language Focus 1–2: he/she dan Pertanyaan
materi.html:
Positif: He hates spiders. She loves dolls. Negatif: He doesn't like clowns. She doesn't watch TV. Bentuk khusus: have → has, go → goes, do → does.

Pertanyaan: Does she like London? — Yes, she does. Does she miss the USA? — No, she doesn't. Wh-: What does she think about British people? Where does she come from?

Latihan modul dengan Sarinder (teman dari Delhi yang tinggal di Brighton): pilih bentuk yang tepat, mis. This is my friend Sarinder. He comes from Delhi… His parents are both doctors… They want to go back to India… Sarinder loves Brighton because he 's got lots of friends here. Kuncinya: subjek tunggal (he) → -s; subjek jamak (his parents, they) → tanpa -s.

materi.heading: ➕ Kalimat dengan subjek jamak tetap tanpa -s
materi.html: My parents live in Delhi. (bukan lives) — Ben and Emily work in London. Banyak salah karena lupa subjeknya dua orang.

materi.label: Latihan • Sarinder (gaya modul)
materi.title: Pilih Bentuk Kata Kerja yang Tepat

cells: After Sarinder ___ (finish/finishes) college, his parents want to go back.
Every year they ___ (go/goes) back to India.
Sometimes he ___ (miss/misses) his grandparents' big house.
They ___ ('s got/'ve got) a fantastic garden.

materi.label: Bagian 3
materi.title: Language Focus 3: Activity Verbs dan Adverbs of Frequency
materi.html:
Kata kerja aktivitas berpasangan dengan kata tertentu: read a newspaper, go swimming, play football, write a letter, listen to the radio, watch television, go to school, visit friends, do nothing, have a meal. Tambahan modul: shopping, a magazine, the cinema, an e-mail, the guitar, CDs, a video, computer games, a restaurant, a shower, your relatives, your homework.

Adverbs of frequency (always, usually, often, sometimes, not … often, never) diletakkan sebelum kata kerja di kalimat positif dan setelah don't di kalimat negatif. Pertanyaan modul: Do you ever go to concerts? — Not often. How about you?

parts.label: sometimes
parts.text: Paling fleksibel: boleh di awal kalimat juga. Sometimes I cook.

parts.label: often

materi.label: Bagian 4
materi.title: Task: Find an E-mail Friend
materi.html:
Teresa (21 tahun, mahasiswi musik dari Cork, Irlandia) menulis profil di situs Findmeafriend.com: ia loves semua jenis musik, suka menulis dan bermain piano serta gitar, bioskop, membaca, internet, anjing, menyetir, keluar dengan teman, traveling, dan berbahasa Spanyol; ia hates sepak bola (dan semua olahraga), laba-laba, kucing, makan daging, dan tidak melakukan apa pun.

Ungkapan tugas: Where is … from? How old is …? Is … a student? What … like? What languages … speak? Diskusi: I think … is best because (he likes music, too). … isn't good because (he doesn't like classical music). I agree / I don't agree. Maybe … Yes, but …

materi.label: Bagian 5
materi.title: Real Life: Asking Politely
materi.html:
Lima percakapan di café: Excuse me. I'd like the bill, please. • Do you want milk? — No, thanks. I'm fine. • Excuse me. I'd like three lemonades, please. — Anything else? — No, thank you. • I'd like one of those, please. — The chocolate ones? — Yes, please. • Do you want a drink? — That's a good idea!

Intonasi: suara yang naik-turun lebar terdengar sopan; datar terdengar kasar atau bosan.

options.label: Kurang sopan
options.title: I want …
options.text: Terdengar seperti menuntut, terutama ke pelayan.

options.label: Sopan
options.title: I'd like … / Can I have …?
options.code: I'd like a coffee, please. Can I have the bill, please?

options.label: Menawarkan
options.title: Would you like …?
options.code: Would you like some milk? — Yes, please. / No, thank you.
options.text: Lebih sopan dari Do you want …? (modul memakai keduanya).

items.en: Excuse me. I'd like the bill, please.
